caveat_text.CONTAMINATION: the 4B vs 9B WikiText comparison may partly reflect memorisation (005)
caveat_text.CONTRARY_TO_PREDICTION: a Holm-resolved quality relation runs against the H-A5 prediction
caveat_text.CORE_A_B_SEPARATE: Core A and Core B are not comparable (different engine, precision, format)
caveat_text.CORE_B_FIXED_DEPLOYMENT: Core B is one model / precision / server config; only client concurrency varies
caveat_text.CROSS_SIZE_UNMEASURED: 4B vs 9B quality is unmeasured except the paired H-A5(a) test (005)
caveat_text.DOWNSTREAM_CI_NOT_REVERIFIED: downstream ci95 / resolved are copied from analysis.json (not re-verified); descriptive, no multiplicity correction (005)
caveat_text.H_B1_UNREFUTABLE: the grid does not reach 4 x C_knee, so H-B1 cannot be refuted at this L
caveat_text.KNEE_AT_GRID_TOP: C_knee is the largest grid C
caveat_text.KNEE_POINT_ESTIMATE: C_knee is a point estimate on the restart means (frozen definition, no noise rule)
caveat_text.KV_USAGE_INCLUDES_GDN: vLLM KV cache usage % includes the GDN state blocks (§3)
caveat_text.MAC_POWER_CONDITION: Mac session conditions: AC with the Apple 70W USB-C Power Adapter, one powermode per session (019)
caveat_text.MIXED_AT_KNEE_ONLY: the mixed request mix is measured only at the uniform C_knee (007)
caveat_text.N3_NOISE_RULE: beyond noise = |x - y| > 2 sqrt(SE_x^2 + SE_y^2) with n = 3 processes (§2); lenient at df = 2, applied as frozen
caveat_text.NOISE_CYCLE: dominance within noise forms a cycle; all its members are kept
caveat_text.NO_IMATRIX_Q4: Q4_K_M is a plain k-quant without imatrix (004)
caveat_text.NO_RANKING: no Mac vs PC ranking (SPEC): each platform's values are only compared within that platform
caveat_text.NO_TESTABLE_UNITS: the verdict has no testable unit behind it
caveat_text.PROVISIONAL: a configuration at this level is not measured / error / incomplete and could change the pick
caveat_text.QUALITY_CTX_512: quality measured at -c 512 (005); long-context quality not measured
caveat_text.QUALITY_PLATFORM_MAC: quality measured on wsl2-cuda (020), applied as a model x quant property (SPEC); not measured on Metal
caveat_text.SPILL_EXCLUDED: a configuration that spills to system memory is not a fit (004) and is never a candidate
caveat_text.TIE_NOT_EQUIVALENCE: tie = not resolved / within noise; no equivalence is claimed
caveat_text.TTFT_ENGINE_ONLY: TTFT is llama-bench engine time: no tokenize / HTTP / sampling (§3)
